headline: Last session: Sensex soared nearly 700 points as Nifty crossed 25,700 while markets remain closed for weekend

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: On the last trading day, strong buying momentum drove Sensex up nearly 700 points.
Nifty surpassed the key level of 25,700 supported by a positive market undertone.
Reliance Brands showed financial improvement with narrowing losses and higher revenue in FY26.
Global tech selloffs pressured US markets, though Indian markets sustained momentum in the last session.
whatHappening: Indian stock markets are closed today, Sunday, November 22, 2026, for the weekend.
In the last trading session, Sensex soared close to 700 points while Nifty crossed 25,700.
Reliance Brands reported FY26 revenue up 3.8% to ₹3,390.9 crore with loss narrowing to ₹137 crore.
Global markets faced headwinds as Nasdaq wiped out 2026 gains and Dow slipped into correction.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today on account of the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 23 November. In the last trading session, benchmark indices rallied strongly, with Sensex jumping nearly 700 points and Nifty crossing 25,700. On the corporate front, Reliance Brands reported a 3.8% revenue increase and narrowed its loss.
